title: Task page offers "Run to PR" on a finished task
description:
On the task page, a task that is already finished (Done / Completed in the tracker) still offers the main **Run to PR** button. Pressing it spends one of the free tier's daily runs on work that has nothing left to run.

## Why it matters

The server picks the main action (`mainActionOf`, `lib/task-state.js`) from the `/state` read, which never reads the tracker, so it cannot know the task is finished. LIN-4042 (PR #2194, merged as 531275aa) fixed this on Home only, by reading the browser's row record (`row.finished`) in `renderRunBlock`. The task page renders its main button through `renderGo` (the `task` surface has `runBox: false`, `public/prompt-section.js` around lines 263 and 276), which does not read `finished`, so it is still affected.

## Acceptance

*The original acceptance below was written against a bug that LIN-4071/LIN-4104 had already fixed on the server; it is superseded by the scope decision's done-when, which is what shipped:*

1. A Done task's page with nothing running shows no runs-on line, no Change, no "N of M runs left today" and no Go. It keeps the "Nothing comes next: this task is finished." line, Another step and any staged proposals.
2. A Done task with a run running or queued shows the running or queued box with Stop / Undo, as Home does, and when that run ends the page drops the Stop and runs-on without a reload.
3. A Done row on Swipe offers no Go (also when the daily quota is spent or run set-up is pending).
4. Unfinished tasks, and tasks with open subtasks, paint as before.
5. Invariant: "finished means no run offer" is decided once, in `runOfferOf` on the server; no browser code reads the tracker's word.

<details><summary>Original acceptance (superseded)</summary>

* Open a Done task's page (`/workspace/<urlKey>/task/<identifier>`) with nothing running: no main Run to PR / Go button is offered.
* A finished task with a running or queued run keeps its running or queued box and Stop / Undo.
* Unfinished tasks, and tasks with open subtasks, behave as today.
* A unit test fails before the change and passes after (see `tests/unit/lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr.test.js` for the vm-sandbox render pattern).

</details>

## Anchors

* `lib/task-state.js`: `runOfferOf` / `NO_RUN_ACTION` (the one place "finished ⇒ no run" is decided)
* `lib/render-task-page.js`: `renderTaskRunControl` (mount gate `model.finished && !model.live`), `renderNextLine`
* `public/prompt-section.js`: `renderGo` (finished branch, quota span), the `!caps.runBox` branch of `renderRunBlock`, `paintState` (run-slot repaint)
* Tests: `tests/unit/lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr.test.js`, `tests/unit/lin-3975-task-run-control.test.js`, `tests/e2e/lin-4048-finished-task-run.spec.js`
* Related: LIN-4040 (run-button rework; folding the task page's run block into Home's `runBox` stays there), LIN-4042 (Home fix), LIN-4247 (state.go staleness follow-up)

*The earlier anchors named* `mainActionOf` *and* `row.finished`*; both are gone.*

## Unvalidated idea

Either feed the tracker state into the task page's `/state` read so the server's main action is null for a finished task (the "server decides" direction LIN-4016 took; it would also fix Home at the cause), or have the task page read `finished` the way Home now does. If LIN-4040 lands first and its three-button design already handles finished tasks, close this as covered.

Priority reasoning: Medium. It costs a user a free-tier run only when they press a button on an already-finished task, but every finished task's page is affected.

## How to go about it (from a Survey before work began)

Two Surveys at LinearViewer `13fe24a04` (on LIN-4150) agree: **the main-button bug as written is already fixed.** `mainActionOf` and the browser's `row.finished` no longer exist. LIN-4071 (#2222) and LIN-4104 (#2225) moved the decision to the server: `buildRowStates` sets `action: finished ? NO_RUN_ACTION : …`, `/state` forwards it, and `renderGo` draws nothing for `kind: 'none'`. Both Surveys probed the real `/state` route (Completed, Canceled, Completed-with-failed-stage leaves all return `{kind:'none'}`), and `tests/unit/lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr.test.js` already has a passing `surface: 'task'` finished case. **Don't add a browser-side** `finished` **read again;** LIN-4071 removed it on purpose ("no surface reads the tracker's word").

What is still real, one each:

* **The finished task page still paints run chrome (global).** `renderRunBlock`'s `!caps.runBox` branch (task page, Swipe) has no `!active && takesNoRun` early return like Home's, so a Done task's body still shows `opened-task-runs-on`, `run-on-what` and `run-change` (a "runs on … / Change" line for a run that can't happen), and the quota span prints "N of M runs left today" beside no button.
* **A Done task with a run still held gets no Stop (open-0).** `renderTaskRunControl` (`lib/render-task-page.js:821`) returns `''` when `model.finished`, so the page-load mount is skipped and a Done task with a running or queued run shows no running box and no Stop / Undo on its task page. Home keeps them. This is acceptance item 2, failing the other way round. Whether it's reachable depends on whether a task can be Done while a run is held (a close-out that marks Done mid-run is the obvious case).

### Scope decision (5 Nov, about 04:00 UTC)

John asked Claude to take the human's role in this process and to err on the side of larger tidies. **The decision: close the reported symptom as covered by LIN-4071/LIN-4104, and spend the task on the two things still wrong, so the task page and Home agree for a finished task.** In pieces:

1. **No run chrome on a finished task page with nothing active.** Give the `!caps.runBox` branch the same `!active && takesNoRun` shape as Home: drop runs-on, Change and the step line, keep `renderRunMore` and the proposals; hide the quota span when `takesNoRun`. A task-surface test asserting no `run-change` / `opened-task-runs-on` on a Done body, red today.
2. **A finished task with a held run keeps its running box and Stop.** First establish whether it's reachable (a task Done while a run is held). If it is: mount the control when `model.finished` but a session is held, and let `/state`'s `none` plus the active run paint the running box; red test in the lin-3975 suite plus a `surface: 'task'` render. If it isn't reachable, say so with the evidence and stop.

**At merge (we'll check it):**

* "finished means no run offer" is still decided once, on the server; no surface reads the tracker's word;
* a Done task's page and Home show the same thing, with nothing running and with a run held;
* **who else must learn about it:** the LIN-4042 test file's header, `llms.txt` if any run-block selector changes, and this ticket's own description (its anchors are stale).

**Not this task's:** folding the task page's run block into Home's (`runBox`); the `caps` table's growing flags belong with LIN-4040's rework.

## Implementation Plan

Session fit: fits one session
plan-review due: no

**Implemented as approved** in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2284](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2284>) (squash-merged as `c70b004c`, deployed to production 5 Nov). Changes 1-7 of the plan landed: mount gate, `renderNextLine` order, the `!runBox` branch, the `renderGo` quota gate, the task-page repaint, Swipe's Go, and docs/tests. Deviations, all from review: `renderGo` now draws nothing for a finished task before its set-up and limit branches (a disabled "Go · daily run limit reached" had been left), plus witnesses for the quota and Change-panel gates and a browser spec. Residual `state.go` staleness was kept out of scope and is filed as LIN-4247. The full plan and the research findings are preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Research notes (LIN-4048), LinearViewer @ `13fe24a0` (origin/main)

### Re-grounding (staleness)
Since this ticket was created, `public/prompt-section.js`, `lib/render-task-page.js`, `routes/task-page.js`, `lib/task-state.js` and the LIN-4042 test changed in LIN-4069/4070/4071/4103/4104/4106/4107/4040-fixes/4179/4242. `mainActionOf` and `row.finished` are gone, and `grep -rn "mainActionOf\|row.finished" lib public` returns nothing. The original "Run to PR on a finished task" symptom is closed by the server: `runOfferOf` returns `NO_RUN_ACTION` first when `finished` (`lib/task-state.js:310-311`), even if something is busy. I re-read every anchor below at HEAD.

### Spike (a vm-sandbox render with the real `/state` route via `tests/fixtures/state-route.js`; the scratch test was deleted after the run)
| case | surface | what renders |
|---|---|---|
| A. Done, nothing held | task | `opened-task-runs-on` ✔, `run-change` ✔, `run-on-what` ✔, `opened-task-run-quota` ✔ ("7 of 10 runs left today"), `run-another` ✔; no step line, no Go |
| B. Done, run held (running, cli) | task | `/state`: action `none`, `running` set, `canStop` true, `live` true, status `running`. Renders `opened-task-started` + `opened-task-running` + `run-stop` ✔, **plus** the runs-on line and Change |
| C. same body as B | home | running box + Stop, no runs-on (it already agrees) |
| E. B's taskState | – | `{state:'running', finished:true, action:'none', busy:true}` |
| F. Done, nothing held | **swipe** | **`data-action="go"` Go button and the `run-step` rung both render** |

So once mounted, the task surface's Stop works. What is actually stopping acceptance item 2 is the **mount gate**, not the render.

### Per-layer audit

**L1. Page-load mount gate**, `lib/render-task-page.js:821`: `if (!promptOpts || model.finished || !model.issueId) return '';`. A Done task's page never mounts the run control. The slot then falls to `renderNextLine` (`lib/render-task-page.js:965`, `owner.runControl || renderNextLine(...)`), which says "Nothing comes next: this task is finished." (`:267`). It checks `model.finished` **before** the running branch, so a Done+held task reads "finished" in the slot while the header pill says running. The gate was introduced in LIN-3975 (`2ab5e675`) and is pinned by `tests/unit/lin-3975-task-run-control.test.js:339`. `model.finished` = `isTerminalState(trackerType)` (`lib/task-page-loader.js:962`, which covers completed, canceled and duplicate). `model.live` = `sessionFactsOf(...).live` = `!!held`, i.e. running or queued (`lib/task-page-loader.js:959`, `lib/task-state.js:55-66`). This is exactly "a run is held", the same `held` that Stop targets.

**L2. Is "Done while a run is held" reachable? Yes, on every close-out.** The close-out stage tells the agent to "set the task to Done", **then** post the summary, close related tickets, archive & prune, and file follow-ups (`lib/prompt-template-defs.js:1021`, `:988`, `:1036`). So the session that set Done keeps running for minutes afterwards. The tracker can also be set Done by hand while a queued item waits. Nothing closes a live run when its ticket goes terminal: `lib/ticket-close-closer.js` only closes rows after a quiet bound and `TICKET_CLOSED_GRACE_MS`. Opening (or reloading) the task page in that window gives no running box, no Stop and no Undo. Home keeps them (spike C; `tests/unit/lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr.test.js:192`).

**L3. Server decision**, `lib/task-state.js:287-311` (`NO_RUN_ACTION`, `runOfferOf`). `finished` wins over busy, needs-you and container. `/state` forwards it as `sessions.action` (`routes/task-page.js:210-275`), and the page-load row record carries the same decision (`routes/task-page.js:181`, `rowRecordOf({ stateType, decided: taskState })`). **Must stay the only place "finished ⇒ no run" is decided.** The browser reads it through `runOfferOf`/`takesNoRun` (`public/prompt-section.js:678-688`), and nowhere reads the tracker word.

**L4. Task-surface run block**, `renderRunBlock`'s `!caps.runBox` branch (`public/prompt-section.js:1593-1605`). It always draws `renderStepLine` (already empty under `takesNoRun`, `:1257`), `renderRunsOn` (no `takesNoRun` gate, `:1194`), the Change panel, `renderGo`, proposals, `renderAfterRun`, `renderRunMore`. Home's branch has `if (!active && takesNoRun(...))` (`:1610`), which paints only `renderRunMore` + proposals + the last line, and its active branch draws no runs-on. **Gap: runs-on, Change and the quota line on a finished task, both idle (A) and held (B).**

**L5. `renderGo` quota span**, `public/prompt-section.js:333-335`. It prints whenever `quotaKnown`, whatever the offer. Under `none` with nothing active, Go draws no button (`caps.sharedButtons`, `:309-317`), so the allowance stands beside nothing. renderGo is shared by home, task and swipe.

**L6. Task-surface repaint lifecycle (found here, not in the ticket).** The task page's own poller (`public/task-page.js:742-760`) never feeds the run control. Only `setProposals` is wired (`:626-634`). The PromptSection's own poll (`runPoll`, `public/prompt-section.js:2311-2333`) runs only while `state.go` is started/running. It calls `paintState()` and `paintGo()`, and `paintState` returns before its `paintRun()` on any surface without `stateBlock` (`:1084`, `:1092` is `caps.runBox &&`). So on the task page **the run slot (runs-on, Stop/Undo, the step line) is not repainted when a run ends**, and only the Go slot is. Consequence for this ticket: if a Done+held page mounts (after the L1 fix) and the close-out session then ends, the page keeps a stale Stop and runs-on until a reload, and the new `!active && takesNoRun` branch is never reached live. Home repaints through `caps.runBox && runControlOn()`. The same staleness affects unfinished tasks too (Stop lingers and no Go comes back after a run ends until reload). That is LIN-3975's "as it was", and it is the cause of the live disagreement with Home.

**L7. Swipe (sibling surface, same original symptom).** Its card mounts PromptSection with `surface: 'swipe'` and the server-stamped `row` (`public/swipe.js:856-866`). `renderIdle` calls `renderGo` + `renderLadder` (`public/prompt-section.js:703-713`). Swipe has `sharedButtons: false`, so `renderGo` takes the plain `else` branch (`:318-319`) and draws `data-action="go"` **regardless of `runOfferOf`**. Spike F: a Done row with action `none` still gets Go and the run-step rung. Swipe's "Recent activity" group (`lib/render-swipe.js:45`) is the route a Done task would arrive by. I did not trace the data path that proves a Done row reaches Swipe, so treat the reach as *plausible, not verified*. The render-level offer is verified.

**L8. Tests and docs that must learn about it.**
- `tests/unit/lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr.test.js`: the vm pattern. Its `surface:'task'` case (`:259`) only asserts no step/Go and does not check runs-on/Change/quota. Its header needs updating.
- `tests/unit/lin-3975-task-run-control.test.js:339` pins "a finished task has no run control"; it must split into finished+idle (still none) and finished+held (mounted).
- `public/llms.txt:65` describes the task page block and the finished Home box; it needs the finished task-page wording.

### Class list (bounded)
1. **Surfaces that mount the run offer** (bound: `SURFACE_CAPABILITIES`, `public/prompt-section.js:261-265`, plus every `PromptSection.init` caller, `grep -rn "PromptSection.init" public`): **home** (agrees already), **task** (L1, L4, L5, L6), **swipe** (L7). Complete: `SURFACES` is pinned to this table by a unit test (comment `:254-257`).
2. **Pieces of run chrome the `!runBox` branch draws** (bound: the array at `:1596-1604`): step line (already gated), runs-on + Change (gap), Change panel (gap when open), Go/quota (quota gap), proposals (keep), after-run (keep; this is Stop/Undo), More/Another step (keep, steps counted left out per LIN-3833 ruling f9fa6bd7).
3. **Ways a task is finished while a run is held** (bound: writers of the tracker's terminal state plus the run lifecycle): close-out stage mid-session (verified, `prompt-template-defs.js:1021`); a human setting Done/Canceled in the tracker while queued or running (not preventable by Harbour). The full set of production writers is **production data, not source**, so I didn't bound it beyond these two. The fix does not depend on which writer did it.
4. **Places "finished" is read on the task page** (bound: `grep -n finished lib/render-task-page.js`): mount gate `:821`, `renderNextLine` `:267`, close-out/evidence copy `:503-597` (not run chrome, out of scope).

### Options
- **O1 (the ticket's scoped decision): gate the mount on `model.finished && !model.live`, and add a takesNoRun branch to `!runBox`.** Pros: smallest change; finished+idle keeps today's "Nothing comes next" line. Cons: without L6, the page goes stale when the held run ends. It is also a second page-load "finished" read, but it decides *mounting*, not the offer; the offer stays the server's `none`.
- **O2: drop `model.finished` from the gate entirely and let `/state` decide everything.** Pros: one decider. Cons: a finished-idle page would gain an "Another step" list with every step left out, plus proposals, in place of the plain finished line. That is a visible change to every Done page and was not asked for. Rejected.
- **O3: O1 + repaint the run slot on the task surface's poll (L6).** One line: in `paintState`, call `paintRun()` when `runControlOn()` before the `!caps.stateBlock` return, or drop the `caps.runBox &&` condition and move it above. Without it, "a Done task's page and Home show the same thing" holds only at load, not live. Bystander: unfinished task pages now repaint the run slot on each 10s run-poll beat while a run is live. That is the same cost Home already pays, the focus/draft preservation in `paintRun` (`:1132-1151`) covers typing, and it fixes the stale Stop / missing Go after a run ends. Beneficiary, not a tax.

### Recommendation: O3, with Swipe included
1. `lib/render-task-page.js:821`: `if (!promptOpts || (model.finished && !model.live) || !model.issueId) return '';`, and update its JSDoc ("A finished task offers no step, so it has no control **unless a run is held: then it mounts for Stop/Undo**"). Optionally reorder `renderNextLine` so a held run reads "A step is running…" before "finished" (members and guests see that line).
2. `public/prompt-section.js` `!caps.runBox` branch: `const noRun = takesNoRun(state, opts)`. When `!active && noRun`, return the run slot with `renderRunMore(step) + renderStagedProposals()` only. When `noRun` (active or not), skip `renderRunsOn` and the Change panel. `renderGo` (started line) and `renderAfterRun` (Stop/Undo) stay.
3. `renderGo`: print the quota span only when a run can be offered (`quotaKnown && !takesNoRun(state, opts)`). This also removes it beside Home's finished+active running line, where it governs nothing (beneficiary).
4. L6: the task surface repaints its run slot from the run poll (`paintState` → `paintRun` when `runControlOn()`, not only `caps.runBox`).
5. Swipe: in `renderGo`'s plain branch, draw no Go when `takesNoRun(state, opts)`, and have `renderLadder`'s run-step rung honour the same. Red test: spike F as a `surface:'swipe'` case in the LIN-4042 file. If the team prefers to keep Swipe separate, file it as a follow-up instead. The render-level offer is verified; the data reach is not.
6. Tests (red first): LIN-4042 file gets `surface:'task'` Done+idle (no `run-change`/`opened-task-runs-on`/`opened-task-run-quota`, keeps `run-another`) and Done+held (keeps `opened-task-running` + `run-stop`, no runs-on), built from `stateBodyOf` real bodies. `lin-3975-task-run-control.test.js`: finished+`live` mounts `task-page-run-control`, finished+idle does not. Update the LIN-4042 header and `public/llms.txt:65`.

Invariant at merge: "finished ⇒ no run offer" is still decided only in `runOfferOf` (server). The browser reads only `sessions.action` / `row.action`, and the page-load `model.finished` decides only whether there is a control to mount.

**Surface Assessment: [improvement noticed, not required: make the task surface's run poll repaint the run slot (`paintState`'s `caps.runBox && runControlOn()` → `runControlOn()`). Land it inline as step 4. It is a one-line change that is required for the live half of acceptance, not a structural refactor, and it introduces no second representation.]**

## LIN-4048: implementation summary

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2284 (commit 5a878d1e, branch feat/lin-4048-finished-task-page-run-chrome)

**Done:** the task page and Swipe now paint a finished task as Home does, and a Done task with a held run keeps its Stop.
- Task page, Done, nothing held: no runs-on, Change, quota or Go. Keeps the finished line, Another step and proposals.
- Task page, Done, run held: the control mounts (running box with Stop, or queued box with Undo). Mount gate is `(model.finished && !model.live)`. The offer is still the server's `none`.
- Next-step line reads "A step is running" for a held run before the finished word.
- Task-page run slot repaints on the run poll, so Stop and runs-on go when a run ends, without a reload.
- Swipe: a finished row draws no Go. Quota span prints only when a run can be offered (also affects Home).

**Evidence:** new cases were red before the change and green after. Unit suite 23,221 pass, 0 fail. Full Playwright e2e 1,998 passed, 1 skipped. CI on the PR: all checks success (unit, four e2e shards, secret scan, CI success).

**Golden:** the `done` fixture in render-task-page-golden.json changed only in its run slot, because its stale review loop is still running (the control now mounts for it). Other cases unchanged.

**Residual (not in this PR):** after a held run on a Done task ends, a stale "Started." line stays until reload. This is the existing state.go staleness on unfinished tasks too; fixing it also brings Go back on unfinished tasks, which is a separate decision.

**Not touched:** the ticket's Anchors section in the description is stale; left for a human to refresh.

Ready for review.

## Review — LIN-4048

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2284, head `5a878d1e0f61adc44e2e5f3356ada46d9752d9f0` (base `13fe24a0`, still origin/main; no commits since).

CI: green on head 5a878d1e (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success: all SUCCESS).

### Scope vs plan
The diff stays inside the plan's places: `lib/render-task-page.js` (mount gate, `renderNextLine` order), `public/prompt-section.js` (`renderGo` Swipe Go and quota gate, the `!runBox` branch, `paintState` repaint), `public/llms.txt`, the golden `done` fixture, and the LIN-3975 and LIN-4042 tests. The invariant holds: the browser reads only the server's `none` (`takesNoRun` → `sessions.action` / `row.action`). No browser read of the tracker word is reintroduced, and `model.finished` decides only whether to mount. One deviation that does no harm: for Done with nothing active, the `!runBox` branch still calls `renderGo` and `renderAfterRun` instead of returning only More + proposals. Both draw nothing there, except in finding 1 below.

**Not done from the plan:** change 7's "this ticket's stale Anchors section" was left for a human (the implementation summary says so). See the ledger.

### Regression check
`git log -15 main -- public/prompt-section.js lib/render-task-page.js`: LIN-4242, 4179, 4040-fixes, 4106, 4104, 4103, 4071, 4070, 4069, 4042, 4038, 4016. Nothing is reverted or re-applied. LIN-4071's removal of `row.finished` stays intact. LIN-4042's Home early return is untouched, and its Home cases still pass. LIN-3239's quota-beside-Go is kept for every surface that can offer a run.

### Findings

**1. A Done task page still draws a Go when the daily quota is used up (inside: class 2 "Go/quota on the `!runBox` branch", plus done-when 1 "no Go" and "the task page and Home show the same thing").**
`renderGo` (`public/prompt-section.js:306-316` at head) tests `!ready`, then `runsExhausted`, then `starting`, all **before** the branch that reads `takesNoRun`. So on a finished task the `runsExhausted` branch still draws `<button data-testid="opened-task-go" … disabled title="daily run limit reached …">Go</button>`. Home never reaches `renderGo` for a Done+idle task, because of its early return.
Spike (vm render, `/state` action `none`, `freeTier: true`, quota stub `{limited:true, runsUsed:10, remaining:0, limit:10}`):
| surface | remaining 3 | remaining 0 |
|---|---|---|
| home | Another step only | Another step only |
| task | Another step only | **disabled `opened-task-go` "Go · daily run limit reached"** + Another step |
| swipe | nothing | **disabled `opened-task-go`** |
The same ordering gives Swipe a `data-action="setup"` "Go ○ set up ›" on a Done row when `dispatchEnabled:false, runSetup:true`. On the task surface that case draws nothing.
The PR's tests miss this because they assert `doesNotMatch(/data-action="go"/)`, and the exhausted button has no `data-action`.
**Fix (verified):** in `renderGo`, add `} else if (takesNoRun(state, opts)) {` (draws nothing, with a LIN-4048 comment) right after the `started`/`running` branch and before `} else if (!ready) {`. Then turn the Swipe branch `} else if (!takesNoRun(state, opts)) {` back into a plain `} else {`. With that change applied, the spike shows nothing on task and Swipe in all four cases, and the 23 unit files that load `prompt-section.js` / `render-task-page` pass (945/945).

**2. The quota gate has no witness (inside: a claim this PR makes, change 4).**
Mutation: I reverted `if (quotaKnown && !takesNoRun(state, opts))` to `if (quotaKnown)`. The LIN-4042 and LIN-3975 files stay green (22/22, 31/31), and so do all 8 unit files that mention `opened-task-run-quota` / `changeOpen` / `run-change-panel` (203/203). The new assertion "no quota" passes only because the test client never sets `freeTier`, so `runQuota` is always null.
**Fix:** in the LIN-4048 block of `tests/unit/lin-4042-finished-no-run-to-pr.test.js`, have `loadClient`'s `api` stub answer `/api/dispatch/quota`, and pass `freeTier: true`. Add these cases:

## Survey 1a (round 3)

From the revision pass (the review's findings 1–3 plus the browser proof).

**1. Why difficult.** The code was small; the order was the hard part. `renderGo` is a ladder of `else if` branches where position is meaning: `!ready`, `runsExhausted` and `starting` ran before anything read `takesNoRun`. The first pass gated the visible symptom, Swipe's plain Go, at the bottom rung, so the limit and setup buttons above it still drew on a finished task. The tests had the same blind spot. They asserted `data-action="go"`, which the disabled button doesn't carry, and the vm client never set `freeTier`, so the quota branches could not be reached. Most of the work was making those branches reachable in a test, then proving each gate with a mutation.

**2. What I'd do first.** List `renderGo`'s branches against the three surfaces and the offer kinds as a table, and make the test client answer `/api/dispatch/quota`, before touching code. Finding 1 falls straight out of that table.

**3. What I'd tidy.** Decide "no run" once, at the top of the run slot, not in each draw function. `takesNoRun` is now read in the step line, `renderGo`, the quota span, the `!runBox` branch and Home's early return. The empty `else if (takesNoRun)` branch with only a comment is the sign. The vm harness (`makeContainer`, `loadClient`) is copied across test files, and each copy fakes a different slice of `window.api`.

**4. The ideal ticket.** "The task page uses Home's run block." With one run block per offer, this would have been one red test and no change.

**5. What the plan got wrong.** Change 6 said "one condition in `renderGo`'s plain branch". That was the right function at the wrong rung. Change 4's witness, "the existing `prompt-section-run-quota` suite", never covered a finished task, so it witnessed nothing here. The ticket's anchors were stale, as known.

**6. What was left behind.** A new spec, `tests/e2e/lin-4048-finished-task-run.spec.js`, carries a copy of `task-page.spec.js`'s seed helpers (`seedSession`, `runnerToken`, the clear-store `beforeEach`), so they now live in two places with no shared home. Its Done-idle case passes on the pre-PR base too, so it doesn't discriminate; the vm cases do. `lin-4042`'s `loadClient` gained a quota stub that other vm files don't have. One thing got simpler: Swipe's Go is a plain `else` again.

**7. Did the larger scope pay?** Mostly yes. The mount gate and the repaint were what made "a Done page matches Home" true live, not just at load; the browser case shows the held-run box mounting and clearing. Including Swipe cost little: the same reorder fixed it. The price of the larger scope was the class it opened, three surfaces × the `renderGo` branches × offer kinds, which a first pass covered only on the `ready` path, and that took a review round. I'd draw the line where it was drawn, stopping before the `state.go` staleness, and add one rule to the plan: enumerate the branches of every shared draw function touched, not just the call sites.
